name: the decision record is unreachable after a close
note: the old guard. §6.8's close sets status='closed' and the page offers exactly that, so this is the defect this pass fixed: §6.5's record could be written only by NOT closing the call.

name: a second outcome overwrites the first
note: what the guard is actually for: a call that carries an outcome is decided, and the board must not move under a second one.

name: a held call is resolved by recording an outcome
note: §6.6's hold suspends the call and an outcome resolves it. This is the route the hold could be walked around by.

name: the decision record omits the ranking it was made against
note: §6.5: the ranking is the fallback chain, and the record is where "why this and not the runner-up" is written down.

name: the fall-back names an id instead of the solution
the decision record is dated the epoch
note: decidedAt is passed in because the record-before-close order reads a call whose closed_at is still NULL. The mutation keeps the variable referenced so it still compiles -- a mutant that does not build proves nothing.

name: the record stops saying which alternative is the agreed fallback
the adopted solution is not marked as adopted
